entries.2730048403d89073: The business environment section indicates a recognition that growth is slowing, due to further progress in the declining birth rate and intensifying competition from an increase in competing stores. As of the end of the fiscal year ended February 2026, children's photo studios operated 407 stores, and 99.6% of revenue came from the Photo Business.

entries.4cef60c5416a5209: It takes commemorative photos for Shichi-Go-San, Omiyamairi, maternity and baby photography, coming-of-age ceremonies and others, and handles everything from producing and processing the photos to display production and printing. It also offers the coming-of-age furisode rental service 'Furiho' and on-site photography, and its subsidiary manufactures and sells photography costumes.
entries.4f5418b9ce4b7ac0: Its management policy for the next fiscal year is 'Innovate the Present, Toward the Future,' and it states that in the Photo Studio Business it will adopt new ideas and technologies from the customer's perspective, create new value and transform. Under its medium- to long-term management strategy, it adopts 'selection and concentration.' In the Photo Business, it will promote maternity and baby photography, Shichi-Go-San photography and on-site photography, and allocate management resources to the coming-of-age furisode rental business, its existing growth base, and to the school photo business, which is to become a future growth base. In the Costume Manufacturing and Wholesale Business, it indicates that it will close its factory in Kyotango City, Kyoto Prefecture, and consolidate its function into the factory of its China-based subsidiary.

entries.53e86bb020cad27f: It operates children's photo studios in all prefectures and has a structure that handles everything from photography to photo production and processing and costume manufacturing within the group. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was 1,257, and the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

In the Costume Manufacturing and Wholesale Business, it also sells costumes to customers outside the company group.

entries.c28c1e9324c858e3: A business that performs studio photo shooting, production and processing, display production, printing and similar work. It operates the children's photo studio “STUDIO ALICE” nationwide and offers services including shrine visit photos (omiyamairi), Shichi-Go-San photos, maternity and baby photos, Coming-of-Age Day photos, furisode kimono rental service “Furi-ho,” and on-site photography. As of the end of the fiscal year ended February 2026, there were 407 children's photo studios (398 directly operated and 9 franchised). Photo production and processing are handled by the subsidiary JVIS Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥32,794 million, a core business accounting for 99.6% of total revenue.
entries.c388d23069b81aac: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,162 million, down 14.9% year on year.
entries.cb2b90cc4a371b1f: Headquartered in Umeda, Kita Ward, Osaka, it operates two businesses: the photography business centered on the children's photo studio “STUDIO ALICE,” and the costume manufacturing and wholesale business, which manufactures and wholesales costumes for photography.
entries.e4cc9c6805d84373: Headquartered in Umeda, Kita Ward, Osaka, it operates two businesses: the photography business centered on the children's photo studio “STUDIO ALICE,” and the costume manufacturing and wholesale business, which manufactures and wholesales costumes for photography. The company and five subsidiaries and two other affiliated companies form a group; for the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥32,928 million and the number of employees was 1,257. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
